reader_DOM.complete_statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X~μ and Z~N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. These are probability laws. Put mY=comap(snd), H_P=L² classes measurable with respect to mY, P=i∘E[·|Y] and the canonical M:u↦u∘snd. Then H_P=ran(P), P is identity on H_P, and there exists an onto linear isometry e:L²(ν;ℝ)≃H_P with i e=M. There is a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized law is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)); Λ.IsCondKernel S and both Λ marginals equal ν. The same joint reflection F(x,y)=(x,2x−y) gives the involutive selfadjoint isometry U, with Uf=f∘F J-almost everywhere for every f. There is a bounded selfadjoint T on the full real L²(ν), with ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere for each u, and preserved integral. On H_P put A=PUP restricted via i and orthogonal projection, and B=(I_J−P)UPi:H_P→L²(J). Then A=eTe⁻¹ is selfadjoint and contractive, PB=0. There is a bounded positive operator Γ on the real scalar-valued L² space with Γ²=I−T². For the SAME transported Γ_P=eΓe⁻¹, positivity holds and Γ_P²=I_H_P−A²=B*B. There is q∈L²(ν;ℝ) equal to one ν-almost everywhere, with Tq=q and ⟨q,u⟩=∫u dν for every u. Set q_P=e q and H_P^0=ker⟨q_P,·⟩, with its inherited Hilbert structure. Membership is exactly zero ν-mean after e⁻¹. The SAME Γ_P annihilates q_P. Put γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη)>0. There exists Γ_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 equal under inclusion to the restriction of Γ_P, positive with Γ_0−γ I positive. Γ_0 is a unit in the algebra of bounded real operators. There exists a bounded real Inv on this SAME centered space with Inv Γ_0=Γ_0 Inv=I and ‖Inv‖≤1/γ. All probability, normalization, range, root, centering, spectral-gap, unit and inverse facts are internally derived from the original inputs; none is an additional public premise. αη=1 and rank-zero E remain legal. No inverse on full H_P is asserted. Define the actual closed conditional-mean-zero space H_perp=ker P in L²(J;ℝ), with its inherited complete Hilbert structure; this is not merely the globally zero-mean joint space. There exists B_0:H_P^0→H_perp whose inclusion equals B i_0. There exists V_0:H_P^0→H_perp with V_0=B_0 Inv, B_0=V_0 Γ_0, V_0* V_0=I and ‖V_0 f‖=‖f‖ for every f∈H_P^0. All these objects and identities are conclusions from the same original inputs. There exists the canonical bounded residual map R:L²(J;ℝ)→H_perp with i_perp Rg=g−Pg for every joint g. The SAME ambient adjoint satisfies B* g=i_0 B_0* Rg for every joint g; the printed intrinsic block adjoint is recovered on H_perp. For every actual joint f∈L²(J;ℝ) with ∫f dJ=0, there exists f_P∈H_P^0 whose inclusion is E[f|Y]. Put f_perp=Rf and f_V=V_0* f_perp∈the SAME H_P^0. Then B* i_perp f_perp=i_0 Γ_0 f_V=Γ_P i_0 f_V, ‖f‖²=‖f_P‖²+‖f_perp‖² and ‖f_V‖≤‖f_perp‖. The global zero-mean condition is a quantified input restriction to this concluded implication, not an extra assumption on the potential or an operator certificate. The SAME root commutes with T and its transport commutes with A. The SAME Inv on H_P^0 is selfadjoint. There exists an internally constructed A_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 whose inclusion equals A after inclusion; it is selfadjoint,commutes with Γ_0,satisfies A_0²+Γ_0²=I,and commutes with the SAME Inv. For the same U,R and inclusion of H_perp=ker P, define D=R U inclusion. Its full-domain identity V0*D=-A0 V0* is retained. For EVERY globally mean-zero f in L2(J), let fP be its actual centered conditional-expectation component, fperp=R f and fV=V0* fperp. Define the actual output g=U(P f-(f-P f)), not an abstract pair chosen to satisfy a matrix identity. The theorem proves its global mean is zero internally from invariance of the actual reflected augmentation law and preservation of the integral by conditional expectation. Let gP be the actual centered conditional-expectation component of this SAME g, gperp=R g and gV=V0* gperp. Then gP=A0 fP-Gamma0 fV, gV=Gamma0 fP+A0 fV, and ||gP||^2+||gV||^2=||fP||^2+||fV||^2. Both output components are produced by these actual conditional/polar semantics before proving the formulas; neither is defined as its right-hand side. All previous law/kernel/root/inverse/polar/full-micro and centered-observable conclusions persist with the SAME twelve witnesses and the original six analytic caller conditions. No surjectivity, sharp-energy68 bound, extra regularity or zero-output-mean premise is introduced. For every globally centered actual f and the SAME actual g=U(Pf−(f−Pf)), the already produced conditional/polar components satisfy C(g_P,g_V)−C(f_P,f_V)=−||f_P||²+||f_V||². The half, signs, coefficient one and the same inverse are exact. This identity is proved internally from A_0²+Γ_0²=I, selfadjointness, commutation, the two-sided inverse and the actual projected rotation. No corrector-change certificate, sharp corrector bound, extra domain/smoothness, onto-V_0 or strict endpoint is an additional premise. Every previous clause and all twelve common witnesses persist.
